race.comment: SHEANADH (3) is a progressive mare who followed up her fresh Wodonga win with a sound third at Tatura nearly 3 weeks ago when looking for more ground. The extra 300m is the key, and she has each-way claims again. BOULDEROO (7) was an overdue maiden winner at Donald by a head when producing a big finish from last on the turn. His last start fourth was also good, and in an easier assignment, he can figure in the top 3. BURNING SENSATION (15) resumes from a spell, and maps to receive the run of the race from the pole position. He is worth keeping safe in all combos, especially with Brad Rawiller in the irons. HUSTLE (10) is closing in on her peak fitness, and should be included.
